properties.originalText:
ATS REPORTING OFFICE OPERATIONS REDUCED.
THE PROCESSING OF FPL IS PRIORITIZED FOR ESSENTIAL FLIGHTS FOR
THE PROTECTION OF PEOPLE AND PROPERTY (MEDEVAC AND SAR), AS WELL
AS COMMERCIAL FLIGHTS  
THE SUBMISSION OF FPL AND FLIGHT INTENTIONS FROM NON-COMMERCIAL 
AND MILITARY FLIGHTS CAN BE MADE VIA EMAIL TO 
SEAC-PF-BRIA-BF(A)AVIATION-CIVILE.GOUV.FR AND MUST BE CONFIRMED
BY A RECEIPT ACKNOWLEDGMENT TO ENSURE THE FPL'S CONSIDERATION. 
SUBMISSIONS BY PHONE ARE STILL POSSIBLE AT 40 86 11 51 BUT ARE 
NOT GUARANTEED.

THE FRENCH VERSION OF THIS NOTAM IS C2110/26.
